name: pypi-pyproject-hatchling
note: a PEP 621 package built with hatchling (another standard out-of-tree backend). No setup.py, no backend-path. Must stay safe — guards against inspectPyprojectBuild firing on any build-backend line.

sourceFiles.pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "glowlog"
version = "0.9.0"
description = "structured logging helpers"
requires-python = ">=3.10"

[project.urls]
Source = "https://github.com/glowlog/glowlog"
